LanguageData.Cinder_Separation.label: Amorphous polymer separation
LanguageData.Cinder_Separation.description: Attempt to separate the solid phase from the biological part in amorphous polymers.
LanguageData.Cinder_Separation.discoveredLetterText: Some hostile army units sometimes carry empty bottles like this, which can be obtained by defeating them.You can also obtain it through purchase.

Cinder_Separation.generalRules.rulesStri.li: subject_story->separate armor plates from this strange twisted mixed substance
subject_story->separate some meat with a burnt smell from amorphous polymers
subject_story->exploring the Applications of Amorphous Polymers

LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleMechanism.label: Tentacle mechanism application
LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleMechanism.description: Attempt to artificially cultivate tentacle walking mechanisms using amorphous polymers and install them on mechanical structures.
LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleMechanism.discoveredLette: This is a bioactive part extracted from amorphous polymers with a burnt odor, strangely it does not decay.

Cinder_TentacleMechanism.generalRules.ru.li: subject_story->modify some frontline turrets to enable them to change their deployment positions on their own, so that the turrets can accompany the troops' attacks
subject_story->a completely different way of movement from wheeled, tracked, and mechanical walking, with low noise and strong passability
subject_gerund->make some immovable buildings move automatically

LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleWalkingMechanism.label: Large walking mechanism
LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleWalkingMechanism.descript: A larger tentacle walking mechanism requires further research on the bioactive parts in amorphous polymers to prepare for heavier platforms.
LanguageData.Cinder_TwistedPharmacology.label: Twisted pharmacology
LanguageData.Cinder_TwistedPharmacology.description: Research on the medicinal value of amorphous polymers and the production of agent that enable people to acquire various abilities.

Cinder_TwistedPharmacology.generalRules..li: subject_story->study the influence of different material ratios on the efficacy of pharmaceuticals
subject_story->explore the sources of special skills on Caster
subject_story->find ways to improve the regeneration ability of amorphous polymers
subject_gerund->Can manufacture erosion and regeneration agents with unstable effects

LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyArmor.label: Heavy armor application
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyArmor.description: Further strengthen amorphous polymers for application on heavy defensive armor clothing or other armor.
LanguageData.Cinder_MultipleWarheads.label: Multiple warheads
LanguageData.Cinder_MultipleWarheads.description: An improvement to firearms and ammunition that can cause more damage when bullets hit enemies.
LanguageData.Cinder_PowerTools.label: Polymer tools
LanguageData.Cinder_PowerTools.description: Some power tool weapons driven by amorphous polymer muscles can effectively defeat enemies in close combat. It can also be used as a handy production tool in daily life.
LanguageData.Cinder_ShapedCharges.label: Shaped charges
LanguageData.Cinder_ShapedCharges.description: Research on a bomb based on the principle of energy gathering using conical charges, which focuses a high-temperature and high-pressure metal jet into a line to penetrate thick armor.

Cinder_ShapedCharges.generalRules.rulesS.li: subject_story->analyzing the Principle of the Monroe Effect
subject_story->manufacturing powerful HEAT armor piercing bombs

LanguageData.Cinder_HellfireMissile.label: hellfire missile
LanguageData.Cinder_HellfireMissile.description: Further application of the Monroe effect.
LanguageData.Cinder_WarMachinery.label: War machinery
LanguageData.Cinder_WarMachinery.description: A self disciplined war machine with powerful firepower that can guide Hellfire missiles to destroy heavily armored targets.
LanguageData.Cinder_WarAttacker.label: War attacker
LanguageData.Cinder_WarAttacker.description: Reverse engineer an ancient heavy attack mecha to create a usable heavy armed walking machine.
LanguageData.Cinder_MainBattleWalker.label: main battle walker
LanguageData.Cinder_MainBattleWalker.description: Build the colony's own main battle tank level walker through reverse engineering.
